panels.title: Data status (catalog based)

targets.rawSql:
select h.hypertable_name as "table", min(c.range_start) as first, max(c.range_end) as "latest chunk end",
 extract(epoch from now() - least(max(c.range_end), now())) as age, approximate_row_count((h.hypertable_schema || '.' || h.hypertable_name)::regclass) as "rows (approx)"
from timescaledb_information.hypertables h left join timescaledb_information.chunks c on c.hypertable_schema = h.hypertable_schema and c.hypertable_name = h.hypertable_name
where h.hypertable_schema = 'netztransparenz' group by h.hypertable_schema, h.hypertable_name order by 1

panels.description: Hypertables of schema netztransparenz with the time range covered by their chunks and an approximate row count. The query only reads the catalog, so it returns an empty table (instead of an error) as long as the crawler has not created any table. Age = time since the end of the last chunk (chunks are coarse, so this is only an upper bound for the age of the data).

options.content:
**Netztransparenz** (German TSO platform www.netztransparenz.de, crawler `netztransparenz`, schema `netztransparenz`).

**No data yet.** The crawler needs API credentials (`ipnt_client_id` / `ipnt_client_secret`, see the module docstring of `oeds/crawler/netztransparenz.py`; the data is not
open license and may not be reshared). Without credentials it skips the run and creates no tables. All panels below are written against the tables and columns the crawler
creates (`prognose_solar`, `prognose_wind`, `hochrechnung_*`, `vermarktung_inanspruchnahme_ausgleichsenergie`, `nrv_saldo`, `rz_saldo`, `aktivierte_srl`, `aktivierte_mrl`,
`value_of_avoided_activation`, `redispatch`); until the first crawl they show *relation does not exist* or *No data* - this is expected.

Column names follow the crawler: lower case, spaces replaced by `_`, brackets removed (e.g. `"50hertz_mw"`). Time column is `von` (start of the 15 min interval, UTC), for redispatch `beginn`.

panels.title: Wind and solar: forecast vs extrapolation
Solar peak (extrapolation)

targets.rawSql: select max((coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0))) as v from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_solar where $__timeFilter(von)

panels.description: Highest extrapolated solar feed-in of all four TSO zones in the time range.

panels.title: Wind peak (extrapolation)

targets.rawSql: select max((coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0))) as v from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_wind where $__timeFilter(von)

panels.description: Highest extrapolated wind feed-in of all four TSO zones in the time range.

panels.title: Solar forecast error (mean abs)

targets.rawSql: select avg(abs(h.v - p.v)) as v from (select von, (coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0)) v from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_solar where $__timeFilter(von)) h join (select von, (coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0)) v from netztransparenz.prognose_solar where $__timeFilter(von)) p using(von)

panels.description: Mean absolute difference between extrapolated (actual) and forecast solar feed-in.

panels.title: Wind forecast error (mean abs)

targets.rawSql: select avg(abs(h.v - p.v)) as v from (select von, (coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0)) v from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_wind where $__timeFilter(von)) h join (select von, (coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0)) v from netztransparenz.prognose_wind where $__timeFilter(von)) p using(von)

panels.description: Mean absolute difference between extrapolated (actual) and forecast wind feed-in.

panels.title: Redispatch energy

targets.rawSql: select sum(gesamte_arbeit_mwh)/1000 as v from netztransparenz.redispatch where $__timeFilter(beginn)

panels.description: Total redispatch energy (all directions) started in the time range.

panels.title: Mean NRV balance

targets.rawSql: select avg(deutschland) as v from netztransparenz.nrv_saldo where $__timeFilter(von)

panels.description: Mean net control area balance (NRV-Saldo) of Germany.

panels.title: Solar: forecast vs extrapolation (Germany)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg((coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0))) as "forecast" from netztransparenz.prognose_solar where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg((coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0))) as "extrapolation (actual)" from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_solar where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Solar feed-in forecast (published before delivery) and the extrapolation of actual feed-in (hochrechnung), sum of the four TSO control areas.

panels.title: Wind: forecast vs extrapolation (Germany)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg((coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0))) as "forecast" from netztransparenz.prognose_wind where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg((coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0))) as "extrapolation (actual)" from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_wind where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Wind feed-in forecast (published before delivery) and the extrapolation of actual feed-in (hochrechnung), sum of the four TSO control areas.

panels.title: Solar extrapolation by TSO zone

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg("50hertz_mw") as "50Hertz", avg(amprion_mw) as "Amprion", avg(tennet_tso_mw) as "TenneT", avg(transnetbw_mw) as "TransnetBW" from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_solar where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Extrapolated solar feed-in per TSO control area (50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT, TransnetBW).

panels.title: Wind extrapolation by TSO zone

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg("50hertz_mw") as "50Hertz", avg(amprion_mw) as "Amprion", avg(tennet_tso_mw) as "TenneT", avg(transnetbw_mw) as "TransnetBW" from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_wind where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Extrapolated wind feed-in per TSO control area (50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT, TransnetBW).

panels.title: Forecast error: extrapolation minus forecast

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(h.von,$__interval), avg(h.v - p.v) as "solar" from (select von, (coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0)) v from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_solar where $__timeFilter(von)) h join (select von, (coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0)) v from netztransparenz.prognose_solar where $__timeFilter(von)) p on p.von = h.von group by 1 order by 1

select $__timeGroupAlias(h.von,$__interval), avg(h.v - p.v) as "wind" from (select von, (coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0)) v from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_wind where $__timeFilter(von)) h join (select von, (coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0)) v from netztransparenz.prognose_wind where $__timeFilter(von)) p on p.von = h.von group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Positive = more renewable feed-in than forecast. Errors drive the need for balancing energy.

panels.title: Balancing: system balance and activated reserves
NRV balance (net control area balance, Germany)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg(deutschland) as "NRV-Saldo" from netztransparenz.nrv_saldo where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Quality assured net balance of the German control block (NRV-Saldo); positive = shortage of energy compensated by balancing power. Unit as given in the column 'einheit' (MW).

panels.title: LFC area balance by TSO (RZ-Saldo)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg("50hertz") as "50Hertz", avg(amprion) as "Amprion", avg(tennet_tso) as "TenneT", avg(transnetbw) as "TransnetBW" from netztransparenz.rz_saldo where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Balance of each TSO's control area (Regelzonensaldo).

panels.title: Activated aFRR (SRL), Germany

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg(deutschland_positiv) as "positive", avg(deutschland_negativ) as "negative" from netztransparenz.aktivierte_srl where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Activated automatic frequency restoration reserve (Sekundaerregelleistung), positive and negative direction, quality assured.

panels.title: Activated mFRR (MRL), Germany

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg(deutschland_positiv) as "positive", avg(deutschland_negativ) as "negative" from netztransparenz.aktivierte_mrl where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Activated manual frequency restoration reserve (Minutenreserve), positive and negative direction, quality assured.

panels.title: Activated aFRR by TSO (positive / negative)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg("50hertz_positiv") as "50Hertz", avg(amprion_positiv) as "Amprion", avg(tennet_tso_positiv) as "TenneT", avg(transnetbw_positiv) as "TransnetBW" from netztransparenz.aktivierte_srl where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Positive aFRR activation by TSO control area.

panels.title: Value of avoided activation (VoAA)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg(voaa_positiv) as "positive", avg(voaa_negativ) as "negative" from netztransparenz.value_of_avoided_activation where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Value of avoided activation (VoAA) of the imbalance netting, positive and negative direction, EUR/MWh; used in the imbalance price (reBAP) formula.

panels.title: Used balancing energy (Inanspruchnahme) by TSO

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), sum("50hertz_kwh") as "50Hertz", sum(amprion_kwh) as "Amprion", sum(tennet_tso_kwh) as "TenneT", sum(transnetbw_kwh) as "TransnetBW" from netztransparenz.vermarktung_inanspruchnahme_ausgleichsenergie where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Balancing energy used (Inanspruchnahme Ausgleichsenergie) per TSO control area, kWh summed over the interval.

panels.title: Redispatch energy per day by direction

targets.rawSql: select date_trunc('day', beginn) as time, richtung as metric, sum(gesamte_arbeit_mwh) as "MWh" from netztransparenz.redispatch where $__timeFilter(beginn) group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Redispatch measures (Netz- and Marktbezogene Massnahmen) started per day, energy in MWh by direction (RICHTUNG: increase/decrease of feed-in).

panels.title: Redispatch energy by primary energy source

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(primaerenergieart, 'unknown') as source, sum(gesamte_arbeit_mwh) as "MWh" from netztransparenz.redispatch where $__timeFilter(beginn) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.description: Redispatch energy by primary energy type of the affected plant in the time range.

panels.title: Redispatch energy by reason

targets.rawSql: select grund_der_massnahme as reason, sum(gesamte_arbeit_mwh) as "MWh" from netztransparenz.redispatch where $__timeFilter(beginn) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.description: Reason of the measure (GRUND_DER_MASSNAHME), e.g. grid congestion.

panels.title: Redispatch by instructing TSO

targets.rawSql: select anweisender_uenb as tso, count(*) as measures, sum(gesamte_arbeit_mwh) as "MWh" from netztransparenz.redispatch where $__timeFilter(beginn) group by 1 order by 3 desc

panels.description: Number of measures and energy (MWh) by instructing TSO.

panels.title: Largest redispatch measures

targets.rawSql: select beginn as start, ende as "end", betroffene_anlage as plant, primaerenergieart as source, richtung as direction, maximale_leistung_mw as "max MW", gesamte_arbeit_mwh as "MWh", anweisender_uenb as tso from netztransparenz.redispatch where $__timeFilter(beginn) order by gesamte_arbeit_mwh desc nulls last limit 25

panels.description: The 25 measures with the highest energy in the time range.

panels.title: Solar and wind: extrapolation vs SMARD actuals

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg((coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0))) as "Netztransparenz solar" from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_solar where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1
select $__timeGroupAlias(datum_von,$__interval), avg("photovoltaik_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "SMARD solar" from smard.generation where $__timeFilter(datum_von) group by 1 order by 1

select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg((coalesce("50hertz_mw",0)+coalesce(amprion_mw,0)+coalesce(tennet_tso_mw,0)+coalesce(transnetbw_mw,0))) as "Netztransparenz wind" from netztransparenz.hochrechnung_wind where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

select $__timeGroupAlias(datum_von,$__interval), avg("wind_onshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen" + "wind_offshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "SMARD wind" from smard.generation where $__timeFilter(datum_von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: The same quantities from two sources. The SMARD series is available now and shows the expected shape; the Netztransparenz series stays empty until credentials are configured.

panels.title: Activated aFRR vs aFRR demand (regelleistung.net)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(von,$__interval), avg(deutschland_positiv) as "activated aFRR positive" from netztransparenz.aktivierte_srl where $__timeFilter(von) group by 1 order by 1

select $__timeGroupAlias(date_from,$__interval), avg(demand_mw) as "procured aFRR POS capacity (DE)" from regelleistung.afrr_bedarfe_regelleistung where $__timeFilter(date_from) and area='DE' and product like 'POS%' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Activated positive aFRR (Netztransparenz) against the capacity procured in the tender (regelleistung.net): activation is normally only a fraction of the procured capacity.
